description: The shore of Lake Dvaipayana. Duryodhana has been hiding in the lake (impassable) and is drawn out for the final mace duel with Bhima. Intimate arena, maximum narrative tension.

tiles.note: Muddy shore — Duryodhana's footing is as cursed here as anywhere. Adds tension to a mace duel.
The lake where Duryodhana hid using mystical power. Now impassable. Units cannot retreat into it.

tile_overrides.note: The focal point of the mace duel.

KAURAVA.note: Duryodhana emerges from the lake edge at (8, 7).

special_mechanics.vajra_thighs: Duryodhana's vajra-thighs trait means LowerBodyInvulnerable() — standard strikes to the legs deal 0 damage. The player must discover that only a foul blow (striking the thigh with a non-standard attack command) deals full damage. This unlocks when Duryodhana HP reaches 30% (trigger-thigh-strike → seq_thigh_strike VNScene).
special_mechanics.audience: The rest of the Pandava forces watch from the perimeter (non-combatants). Only Bhima fights. Krishna coaches from the sideline — his presence provides a hint system (VN choice to receive a hint breaks Dharma slightly).
special_mechanics.dharma_note: Bhima striking the thigh is adharmic per Kshatriya rules but canonically fated. fail_on_deviation: true if Duryodhana is not defeated.

directive_notes.trigger: trigger-thigh-strike fires seq_thigh_strike when duryodhana HP < 30%
